_comment: Compaction-survival preset. Merge the 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json for Claude Code (or ~/.codex/hooks.json for Codex — both use the same PreCompact + SessionStart contract). Merge per-event if you already have a hooks block. Adjust the command paths to wherever you copied snapshot.sh / restore.sh; single-quote the path if it contains spaces. Fire-and-forget, never blocks compaction; 10s timeout each. Requires 'jq' on PATH.
